name: Through the Screen
source:
She might not see it coming, but Ariza has fallen for someone. Two dorks, both lost in fanfiction, finding something real in each other.

[From [url=https://astralautumngames.itch.io/through-the-screen]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
她可能没有预见到这一点，但阿里扎已经爱上了某人。两个傻瓜，都迷失在同人小说中，却在彼此身上找到了真实的东西。

[来自[url=https://astralautumngames.itch.io/through-the-screen]Itch.io[/url]]
